title: An American

As the story unfolds, Ruth grapples with her secret marriage to a man entangled in political strife, set against her desire to free prisoners and support the Cuban people's quest for justice. Esther, the political prisoner’s lover, adds to the emotional complexity as Ruth's journey intertwines with hers, leading to a deep exploration of love, loyalty, and the challenges posed by personal and national conflicts.
